what-v2-dark.svg: Articles in an overlay: Shows a list of articles in an overlay. Select an article to read its headline and text. One JSON file: Loads the articles from data/articles.json. Fully responsive: Works on every screen width. Few DOM updates: Builds the DOM with fragments, so the browser does few updates. Dynamic ARIA: Sets ARIA attributes dynamically. Debounced hover: Debouncers keep hover from stealing focus

serve-v2-dark.svg: Docker Compose: Run docker compose build && docker compose up -d. Then open http://localhost:8080 (http://localhost:8080). No Docker: Use any static server on the repo root, for example python3 -m http.server 8080. The page fetches /data/articles.json by absolute path. Never from disk: Do not open index.html from disk (file://). Browsers block ES modules and fetch() there

runtime-v2-dark.svg: Browser: Opens http://localhost:8080 (http://localhost:8080), served by nginx:alpine. It gets index.html, css/main.css and js/index.js (ES modules). Fetch: The module script in index.html calls fetchArticles(). fetch() reads data/articles.json (id, headline, text) as JSON. Buttons: createArticleButtons() builds all buttons in one DocumentFragment: one DOM update for all of them. #overlay: Holds an aside with the article buttons and an article with headline and text. Alle Kategorien opens it. The close button or Escape closes it. Focus, click, hover: Focus or click shows the article at once. Mouseover waits for a 300 ms debounce. ARIA and small screens: aria-hidden and aria-inert follow the overlay and side-menu state. Below 768 px the article list sits behind a side-menu toggle

layout-v2-dark.svg: index.html: Markup + the module script that wires everything up. data/articles.json: The articles: id, headline, text (HTML). js/articles/: Fetch, button factory, button event listeners. js/aria/: ARIA attributes for the overlay and its buttons. js/utility/: Overlay state, side menu, debouncer, Escape key. css/: Variables, layout, components, utilities. fonts/: Roboto Regular + Bold. Dockerfile: nginx:alpine image that serves the folder. docker-compose.yml: Port 8080 -> 80, mounts the folder into nginx
